About OceanDips

Emotional, accessible, beautiful.

  • 🌊 Wild ocean pool dips
  • 🫁 Breathe, relax. Breathe, energize
  • 🚶 SW coastal path walking
  • 🧗 Pranaclimb — climbing taster · instruction · coaching · guiding

Immersive experiences in nature, designed to reconnect you with your breath, your body, and the ocean.

Set along the breathtaking coastline of the North Coast of West Cornwall — each experience is unique, shaped by tide, weather, and light.

Annie creates protocols and practices for each individual and can run a half day or full day on a date to suit you — coastal walk, wild ocean pool dip, breathwork, and sea cliff climbing on the stunning North Cornish coast.

This is not a one time experience — it is a practice, skills and techniques for mindset and resilience — physiologically and psychologically. This is a RAW experience in nature.

The Science Behind Ocean Dips

Grounded in Science.
Inspired by the rawness of nature.

Ocean Dips combines the science of breathing, cold-water immersion, climbing, movement, and nature to create evidence-informed experiences that support health, wellbeing, resilience, and human connection.

Ocean Dips asks: How do breath, cold water, movement, climbing, and nature work together to regulate human physiology and wellbeing?

Ocean Dips is inspired by a growing body of scientific research showing that nature immersion, cold-water exposure, conscious breathing, movement, and climbing can work together to support physical and mental wellbeing. These experiences have been associated with reduced stress and anxiety, improved mood, greater resilience, enhanced focus, better recovery, increased self-confidence, and a deeper connection with nature.

🌬️ Why Cold Water?

Cold water is a powerful physiological and psychological reset. It is a hormetic stressor.

Research shows that cold water immersion can:

  • reduce inflammation and muscle soreness
  • accelerate recovery after exercise
  • improve circulation
  • boost mood and energy
  • increase resilience to stress
  • reduce rate of perceived exertion
  • boost immunity, metabolism and well-being
  • build resilience and grit
  • increase Natural Killer Cells — cytotoxic immune cells with an innate capacity for eliminating cancer cells

It triggers a natural surge in:

⚡ Norepinephrine — focus + alertness 🧠 Dopamine — motivation + mood 💛 Endorphins — well-being

Cold water is a controlled stressor — teaching the body and mind to remain calm under pressure.
